descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S22 Time from Link tap to text on the chart, and pad load with 25 boxes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)
  • U1 Quick Dictation opens from the Hospital home screen (patient list). The physician dictates or types into a box and adds a new box for the next patient, so one pad holds several boxes. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 step 1)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given QA Hosp Patel (415); 25 compartments already on the pad

When Open the pad, wait until all boxes show, type 'Bed 415, stable.' into the last one and tap Link, open Patel's Encounter tab

Then Time to a settled pad and time from tap to text on the chart are recorded per run

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): No UAT or ticket target (Q11): timings are reported as data for Daniela, not judged. Correctness of the placement is judged by S01/S02

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (not-testable)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
